series: plan-D G-parameterization on the portable TQue base
single_hypothesis: When the whole m*D token block exceeds the UB budget (large-D backward family, e.g. m=8 D=7168: 301KB > 196KB), fetching streams TWO per 2D-block DMA (G=2, odd tail handled) halves read commands and contiguous-bursts the reads, cutting backward wall time on large points.
changed_mechanism: tiling.bwdGrouped becomes 3-state: 0 regular, 1 full-m grouping (platform-proven in E4G1), 2 pair grouping when full doesn't fit but 2*D does (host picks by UB budget; rowBlock=1)

kernel ProcessBackwardPaired: per pair one TQue Alloc + 2D-block DataCopy {1, 2*D/16, 0, 0} + EnQue/DeQue; Cast stream 0 (first ever) then Axpy/Add per stream in original k order; odd tail group uses a single-stream copy {1, D/16, 0, 0}; output via outQueue as usual
all constructs remain in the platform-proven family: TQue cadence + 2D block form

simulator.regressions: mode-1 grouped small/m8, D17 fallback, forward small all clean on the new build

expected_platform_effect: Points mapped to large backward (candidates: 6 ~888us, 7 ~744us, 8 ~1.01ms if backward m=8 D~7168) may drop 2-20%; sim says -21.5% wall at (512,5120,8) but real HW is bandwidth-bound so expect the low end. Points 1/2/3 and non-eligible paths byte-identical.
readback_rules: 8/8 required. Watch 6/7/8 for improvement; 1/2/3/4/5 within bands. If large backward points drop >=5us total, keep and harvest this base; if flat, E4G2 still >= E4G1 mechanically (mode-1 paths unchanged) - keep whichever draws better.
verdict: Points 6/7/8 unmoved (mid/high band): like E4C1-forward, large-backward command overhead is hidden under bandwidth. G=2 mechanism mechanically >= all prior paths; nothing separates E4/E4G1/E4G2 in score distribution. Recent family draws cluster ~74.5-75.0 vs earlier 75.4-75.9 (possible platform load drift).
